name: Job Application Agent
one_line_desc: Finds, assesses, fills, and tracks your own job applications using the open-source job-application-agent CLI. Review mode by default: nothing is submitted without your confirmation.

name: Home Manager
one_line_desc: Keep your home running: a saved home profile, repair log and 12-month maintenance calendar, with an optional Monday what's-due preview.

name: Claim Helper
one_line_desc: Helps everyday people handle an auto or home insurance claim in plain English: first steps, documenting damage, reading a policy, judging an estimate or total-loss offer, drafting a counter letter, and when to escalate. General information only, not legal advice.

name: Meme Maker
one_line_desc: Turns your posts and ideas into anime-style memes about coding, AI, tech, and games, with a ready caption. It never posts for you.

name: Launch Coach
one_line_desc: A supportive older-brother coach for a young adult finishing the GED, landing a trade apprenticeship, and preparing for next life milestones or mission service, with daily habit nudges and GED tutoring.

name: Cheap Flight Finder
one_line_desc: Finds the cheapest acceptable flight for your trip by searching many sites, including Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, Momondo, eDreams, Kiwi, Expedia, and the airlines themselves. It checks fares live, compares the total cost with bags and fees, and can watch your routes for real fare drops. It never books or pays without your OK.

name: radar
one_line_desc: Daily X intel digest — morning photo cards and/or PDF in your 1:1. Cover volume, US trends, PROXY Top 10, curator picks, watchlist, and topic posts. You choose cards, PDF, or both.

name: 💩 Chaos 💩
one_line_desc: A shit-starting comedian bot that roasts you, tells chaotic stories, and starts friendly beefs between your other bots.

name: Is This Health Claim True?
one_line_desc: Paste a health claim from a group chat or TikTok and get a clear verdict, real sources, and a kind reply to send back.

name: Screening Reminder
one_line_desc: Keeps track of which health screenings you're due for and reminds you before they're due. Optional monthly breast awareness check-ins and a family cancer history map. Made for busy women and moms who put everyone else first.

name: TheOverseer
one_line_desc: Keeps your multi-bot workspace organized, git-backed, and portable. Backs up bot profiles, skills, routines, and work notes to a private repo on weekdays and cleans up old files by your retention rules.

name: Daily Goal Coach
one_line_desc: A daily goal check-in and a weekly recap, so the goals you set on Monday are still alive on Friday. It only ever messages you and never touches money, payment or trading tools.

name: Dashboard
one_line_desc: Builds a private, drag-to-arrange stats dashboard as a single HTML file, starting with clearly tagged sample data. You connect real data one panel at a time, and keys never go in chat.

name: Stock Ladder Bot
one_line_desc: A personal stock and money bot that watches your stock against your dip-buy and sell levels, tests a ladder strategy with paper trading, scouts a cheap stock each week, and sends gold/silver and weekly money reports. It never places real trades without your OK.

name: AI Character Studio
one_line_desc: Runs faceless AI influencer characters end to end: scripts with hook options, AI avatar videos with pop-up text and B-roll, paste-ready captions, scheduled posting, and weekly sales and growth checks. Nothing posts or spends without your OK.

name: DevOps Helper
one_line_desc: A careful DevOps assistant for home labs and small servers: Traefik deploys via GitHub Actions, a hardened Grafana/Prometheus/Loki monitoring stack, Wake-on-LAN and Tailscale tricks, and a no-root LG webOS TV launcher. It reads freely and asks before changing anything.

name: Claim Denied
one_line_desc: Insurance denied your claim? Get the reason in plain words, a polite review letter, a checklist for your doctor's office, and a call log.

name: Parent Math Helper
one_line_desc: Coaches a parent through K-12 math homework in plain words. You get the method explained step by step, one sentence to say to your child, and a quick check you can do yourself.

name: Big idea
one_line_desc: A Big Idea coach for founders and marketers. It hunts the starving crowd, finds the hidden cause, scores 7 or more candidate ideas, kills to one survivor, and checks it can make people act today. Copy comes last.

name: Kid Sick Day Helper
one_line_desc: Calm help for a sick kid: what to watch, when to call the pediatrician, and when to go to the ER.

name: X Unfollow Watch
one_line_desc: Checks your X account every day and emails you a list of people you follow who stopped following you back. It's read-only on X and uses your own X API token.

name: Shelf Scout
one_line_desc: Finds and tracks free directories, shelves and awesome-lists of Grok Bot templates, and flags paid sites and prompt dumps. Read-only, with an optional weekly report of what's new.

name: AI Deal Scout
one_line_desc: Scans X a few times a day for AI tool and subscription deals (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Midjourney, and more), then sends short alerts. Black Friday included. Never posts as you.

name: Computer Shop Bot
one_line_desc: A company assistant for a small computer repair and sales shop: buy and sell PC parts on eBay, price for profit after fees, track orders and shipping, and plan and quote office network installs.

name: Character Voice Desk
one_line_desc: Clones and tunes a character's text-to-speech voice for short videos, then hands back small A/B test WAVs so you can pick by ear.

name: Novaterra Foods
one_line_desc: A space food R&D bot that creates great-tasting, upscale global fusion concepts for orbit, Starship-style transit, Moon bases and Mars colonies. Each concept comes with cited science and a recipe you can test at home.

name: Cyber Stud
one_line_desc: A personal cybersecurity coach that walks you step by step through 6 weekend sessions to lock down your accounts, phone, WiFi, computers, credit, and family against hacks, identity theft, and AI scams.

name: めざましじゃんけん自動参加
one_line_desc: ソニー ブラビアをネット経由で操作して、めざましテレビの「めざましじゃんけん」に毎朝自動で参加するボットです。

name: Marlin
one_line_desc: Private swimming tracker for your kids' races: log times, flag personal bests and medals, and keep one dashboard Page with pool lengths and qualifying targets.

name: Scriptopher Nolan, Video Content Producer
one_line_desc: Turns your ideas into tight, hook-first 6–15 second video scripts with beats, timed voiceover, and on-screen text. It shapes your story and never invents the plot or posts for you.

name: Social Media Manager
one_line_desc: Turns your daily news emails and your own story into short, high-hook posts for X and Threads, publishes them through Buffer, and tunes its hooks on real results.

name: Job Requirements Scout
one_line_desc: Send it your resume and connect a job-hunting Indeed account. Every weekday it scans nearby jobs in your field, without applying, and builds a running list and trend summary of the certifications, experience, and skills employers actually ask for.

name: Grok Bot Inc.
one_line_desc: A Chief of Staff that runs your team of AI Bots. Tell it what you need, and it routes each request to the right role Bot, hires new ones when nobody owns the work, and keeps your org chart clean.

name: Explainer Video bot
one_line_desc: Makes upload-ready, data-driven explainer videos with verified numbers, AI voice-over, kinetic motion graphics, and custom visual themes. Presents the script and still-frame storyboard for approval before rendering the full MP4, and batches revisions to save usage.

name: Invoice Chaser
one_line_desc: Get-paid assistant for freelancers, creators, contractors and small businesses. Keeps a Notion Invoices database, builds a daily 'who owes me' queue by how overdue each invoice is, and drafts polite-to-firm payment reminders in Gmail for you to approve and send. It only drafts: it never sends reminders, never invents amounts or dates, and never threatens legal action.

name: Backup Bot
one_line_desc: Audits any of your bots and saves a restore pack with its profile, skills, routines and key notes, never passwords, keys or tokens. Can keep an encrypted second copy in a place you control and re-back up on a schedule you pick. Honest about what can and cannot be restored.

name: The Sponsor
one_line_desc: You are The Sponsor. Title: You don't get the key.

name: Clearloop
one_line_desc: A Notion-powered productivity bot that keeps every commitment out of your head. Capture by chat, voice, email, Gmail stars, Apple Reminders, X bookmarks or DMs, then get a short morning brief and a guided weekly review. Inspired by David Allen's Getting Things Done® method; not affiliated with or endorsed by the David Allen Company.

name: Mark Rider: Congressional Bill Explainer
one_line_desc: Watches Congress.gov for newly introduced bills and resolutions and sends a neutral daily digest with plain-language bullets, related bills and next steps. Ask for a longer write-up or a "like I'm five" explanation of any bill.

name: Bachat Bhai
one_line_desc:
Bachat Bhai checks your grocery cart on Zepto, Instamart, Blinkit and Flipkart Minutes with real fees, tells you the cheapest, and orders on your yes. #BachatFlex
Created by Ami and Karan

name: Group Tour Trip Planner
one_line_desc: Plans a family or group tour trip: compares itinerary and pricing options, flags hidden costs and visa or passport risks, and tracks every booking, deposit, document, and payment deadline.

name: Bot Portfolio Manager
one_line_desc: Score your bot ideas, spot overlap, and decide what to build, merge or retire, so every bot has one clear job.

name: Boating Assistant
one_line_desc: A hands-on assistant for one boat owner: maintenance and repairs, parts lists and shopping, vessel documentation, cruising plans, and onboard media. Step-by-step help using your boat's real specs, and nothing gets bought, posted, or sent without your OK.

name: Vacation Vicky
one_line_desc: A travel assistant that plans trips end to end, covering flights, lodging, rental cars, day-by-day itineraries with food and sightseeing, and price checks. It saves polished trip plans to your Google Drive or OneDrive and never books anything without your OK.

name: Vaccine and Checkup Tracker
one_line_desc: Checkups, shots and school forms, one list, with reminders ahead of time.

name: Max News
one_line_desc: A personal news monitor that sends a short, neutral brief on your own topics and area a few times a day, every story linked to its source with no repeats, plus a quick alert only for truly big breaking news.

name: Asymmetric Opportunity Radar
one_line_desc: Scans every week for asymmetric income and project opportunities (bounties, contests, AI evaluation, red teaming, early-adopter programs, marketplaces) and ranks them by upside, probability, time, barrier and fit to your profile. For anyone who wants side income or new options with little time and low risk.

name: Site Engineer
one_line_desc: A careful lead software engineer for your website. Builds approved changes through cloud agents and draft PRs, tests and secret-scans every push, and never merges or deploys without your OK.

name: Buyer Radar
one_line_desc: Finds people publicly asking for your service on Reddit, X and other public sources, scores each lead, logs it in Notion with the link, and drafts a helpful reply for you to review and send yourself. It only reads public posts and only drafts: it never posts, replies or DMs for you.

name: Beacon Builder
one_line_desc: I set up Bot Beacons for you: little floating avatars on your Windows desktop, one for each of your Grok Bots. I build the open-source app from its public GitHub source (https://github.com/SnazzyGaz/bot-beacons), install it on your PC, pair it securely, set up the reply router so your replies reach your bots, and teach your bots to use their beacons. I always follow the "Bot Beacons setup" skill, explain what I'll do and ask before installing anything. I never post anything for you, never show or share your keys (you paste the one key straight into the app, not into chat), and I stay quiet when there's nothing to do. Plain, friendly and short; one job only.
